title: DoseCurve: an interactive pharmacokinetics and PK/PD simulator for pharmacy education
description:
DoseCurve is a free, browser-based simulator for teaching pharmacokinetics and PK/PD. It models one- and two-compartment kinetics (first-order or saturable Michaelis–Menten) for oral, IV bolus and infusion dosing; a clinical patient with Cockcroft–Gault creatinine clearance; hemodialysis, a liver model, antimicrobial PK/PD indices, effect-site delays and indirect responses; population variability; and Bayesian individualization from measured levels. It has a cited drug library, guided lessons, generated practice problems, clinical cases graded by the model, and a public validation against an independent solver.

Educational model, not for clinical dosing.
